The '''Javarica system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Tynquay sector/Legends|Tynquay sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] regions.<ref name="Trans-Hydian" /> The system was the origin point of the [[Javarican espresso]].<ref name="Red Harvest">[[Red Harvest (novel)|''Red Harvest'']]</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Javarican espresso]]|system=Javarica [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Javarica system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square Q-4.<ref name="EAOC" />
